impact.text: Loss of user rewards upon merging/splitting

precondition_sources.text: A veNFT involved in a merge (as from) or split has pending earned rewards.

intent_sources.text: Merging or splitting a veNFT with pending rewards must not cause the owner to lose those earned rewards.
